title: Say Sakey ya Diad Arap na Saray Tanda To et Inmabeba so sakey a Panarian
intro: Sakey a makapadinayew a biahe so manaalagar ed saramay makpel a mansolbar ed sayan misteryo. Diad aralem na saray pahina na Apocalipsis, walay sakey a soberano ya say pitongtong to ed sakey a propeta so mamasimbalo ed interon bansa. Sayan pigura so nanuley manlapud arawin trono, ya inggiya na kadaanan iran tradisyon, anggad sakey ya ekstraordinaryon bekta na madibinon katuaan so anguman ed manuley tan panarian ed andi-anggaan. Naamtaan mo kasi so pakabidbiran na sayan makapadinayew a kamarerwa ya say istorya to et mankakasakey ed nikadkaduman tan aralem?
clues: Inuleyan ko so sakey a maaligwas a bansa ed biek na ararawin danum, a bantog lapud saray hardin tan atagey a palasyo mi.
Say autoridad ko so sankatageyan, balet ta walay baleg a panarian ya sinmabi pian suppiatan so mismon kiwawala tan inkatoo mi.
Sakey a melag a manok so walaan na nikadkaduman mensahe, tan saray makapakelkelaw ya tinmumbok so amawala na amin ya iisipen ko nipaakar ed pakayari.
Nen anengneng ko so sakey a trono ya anguman ed arap na matak, amtak ya anggapoy too ya walaan na ontan iran abilidad.
Maparungtal kon indeklara so panagpasakop ko ed saksakey a Katawan na tawen tan dalin, ya inkaindan ko so amin ya datin papablien ko.
Sikatayo, bilang sakey a bansa, et inmarawi ed kadaanan a panagdayew ed agew tan inawat tayo so katuaan ya anguman ed amin.

options: Makadesyang a delap ya aneral ed panarian

Sakey a yegyeg ya angakmon ed palasyo na ari
trial.answer: Makaawat na misteryoson mensahe panamegley na nikadkaduman manok

location.label: Manunan Lokasyon
options: Say Ilog Nilo ed kadaanan ya Ehipto
Say Sagradon Santuaryo na Makkah
Say Sular nen Propeta Dawud
Say Yemen tan saray maawaran a hardin to
Saray patar na Jerusalem

outcome.label: Say Pansumpalan
options: Say panarian so aderal bilang dusa ed agpanisia
Inasawa ko si Propeta Sulayman tan nanayam ak ed Jerusalem
Inmabuloy kami ed si Allah tan inawat mi so tuan pananisia
Pinmawil ak ed tronok tan intuloy koy nanuley a singa dati
Say bansa so adakep tan inloob ed sananey ya empiryo
outcome.answer: Inmabuloy kami ed si Allah tan inawat mi so tuan pananisia

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
